guides.name: Gladiator PvP: control and burst — GamerBlurb

$join.$t: PvP-гайд из интернета, не с Questlog: {site}, автор {author}. Собран помощником по статье — сверяйтесь с оригиналом.

$join: A control-first PvP setup: open with Blade Toss from range, close in with Leaping Slam, knock down with Mocking Blade and punish the opening with Overhead Slam and Aerial Snare. The stigmas lean defensive (Armor of Balance, Tenaciousness) so you outlast the enemy's control, and gear favours Accuracy and Status Effect Chance over small damage gains.

tips.title: Keep a gap closer in reserve
tips.text: Do not burn Leaping Slam and Rush Strike on the first engage: mobile classes such as Rangers and Sorcerers will slip away and leave you stranded.

tips.title: Defensives before control
tips.text: Armor of Balance goes up before the enemy's control lands. Tenaciousness is the emergency button, and Defiance is for the crowd control that would otherwise end your engage.

tips.title: Stigma swaps
tips.text: Rage Burst instead of Tenaciousness adds pressure but removes the strongest survival tool. Focused Block is worth it against opponents whose hits you can block; Armor of Balance is safer when control is the bigger threat.

tips.title: Accuracy first
tips.text: A missed hit does nothing, so Accuracy comes before small damage gains. Keep enough HP and PvP Damage Tolerance to stay on the front line without constantly backing off.

guides.name: Gladiator PvP: knockdown chain — AOEAH

$join.$t: PvP-гайд из интернета, не с Questlog: {site}, автор {author}. Собран помощником по статье — сверяйтесь с оригиналом.

$join: A small-group PvP build built around chaining knockdowns: Mocking Blade, Rush Strike and Aerial Snare are maxed, Overhead Slam gets moderate investment. Passives and Arcana favour survival and control, and stats put PvP damage reduction and status resistance ahead of offence. Kiting is named as the class's main weakness.

tips.title: Small fights, not zergs
tips.text: In small team fights, engage, absorb the first wave with parry and invulnerability, then chain control on the enemy backline or healers. In large mass PvP, ranged AoE kills a melee Gladiator quickly.

tips.title: Watch for kiting
tips.text: Kiting is the class's main weakness: keep Rush Strike and Leaping Slam for ranged targets that try to keep distance.

tips.title: Skip in PvP
tips.text: Sword Aura Rampage and Crushing Wave are not recommended for PvP; spend the points on the knockdown chain instead.

tips.title: Control and defensives by hand
tips.text: Press crowd control and survival skills manually so they land at the right moment instead of whenever a macro reaches them.

guides.name: Gladiator PvP (editorial) — MetaBot

$join.$t: PvP-гайд из интернета, не с Questlog: {site}, автор {author}. Собран помощником по статье — сверяйтесь с оригиналом.

$join: A compact editorial PvP build for the current patch: both gap closers and the knockdown, launch and slam chain trained to Lv. 10 with skill points, Aerial Snare lower because of its long cooldown. Survival Willpower replaces a damage passive, since PvP is decided by who gets controlled less. The stigmas bring an attack buff, Combat Speed, full immunity and an AoE knockdown for group fights.

tips.title: Control decides PvP
tips.text: The build gives up a damage passive for Survival Willpower: whoever spends less time controlled usually wins the fight.

tips.title: Two gap closers
tips.text: Leaping Slam and Rush Strike are both trained to 10 so you can keep up with kiting targets.

tips.title: Aerial Snare can stay lower
tips.text: Its long cooldown means extra levels pay off less often, so it stops at 7 while the rest of the chain is at 10.

tips.title: Stigma roles
tips.text: Zikel's Blessing for the attack buff, Lunge Stance for Combat Speed, Tenaciousness for full immunity, and Wrath Wave as an AoE knockdown for group fights.
